title: 我高兴地跟你说哈，我们第三季度的活儿搞得比计划还早。
content_text:
我高兴地跟你说哈，我们第三季度的活儿搞得比计划还早。
[I'm pleased to report that we're ahead of schedule on the Q3 deliverables.]
不过话说回来，联调阶段比预想的要拖得久，可能得加人手。
[That said, the integration testing phase is taking longer than expected, so we may need to allocate additional resources.]
说句实在话，我还是有点不放心，毕竟太依赖那个第三方接口了，要是它慢了，就会一环扣一环，搞出大乱子。
[Honestly, I'm a bit concerned about the dependency on the third-party API — any delay there will cascade.]
明天早上我们约个时间碰一哈，盘算一下时间表，看是往上推还是改一下计划。
[Let's sync tomorrow morning to reassess the timeline and decide whether to escalate or adjust the scope.]

sentences.text: 我高兴地跟你说哈，我们第三季度的活儿搞得比计划还早。
I'm pleased to report that we're ahead of schedule on the Q3 deliverables.
不过话说回来，联调阶段比预想的要拖得久，可能得加人手。
That said, the integration testing phase is taking longer than expected, so we may need to allocate additional resources.
说句实在话，我还是有点不放心，毕竟太依赖那个第三方接口了，要是它慢了，就会一环扣一环，搞出大乱子。
Honestly, I'm a bit concerned about the dependency on the third-party API — any delay there will cascade.
明天早上我们约个时间碰一哈，盘算一下时间表，看是往上推还是改一下计划。
Let's sync tomorrow morning to reassess the timeline and decide whether to escalate or adjust the scope.
